CI: .github/workflows/e2e.yml runs the same suite on pull_request and push to main with SHA-pinned actions and `npm ci`. WHY NOT P4: SCHEMA.md requires template + CI + security scan + rollback path. Template and CI exist. The security scan does NOT cover this technology: .github/workflows/codeql.yml analyses `languages: python` and `languages: actions` only, and .github/dependabot.yml declares only the `github-actions` and `pip` ecosystems - there is no `npm` ecosystem entry, so nothing scans package-lock.json.
